搜尋考卷名稱或題目內容: Search exam titles or question text

（有的模型沒有價格，沒算進去）: (Some models have no price and aren't counted)

每寫完一題就看對錯: See right or wrong after each question

每個人的選項順序不同: Shuffle choice order for each student

存放檔案的空間這次沒有回應，題目已經讀好了。過一下再按重新辨識。: File storage didn't respond this time, but the questions were read. Wait a moment, then tap Rescan.
這個模型不在免費額度裡: This model isn't in the free tier

做題時把題目和選項翻成介面語言。: Translates questions and options into the app language while you answer.
{n} 項是你自己選的模型，其他跟著「{strength}」。按一格就全部改回自: {n} use a model you picked; the rest follow “{strength}”. Tap a level to set them all back to Auto.
題目有圖時改用這個模型；只列看得懂圖的模型。: Used instead for questions with pictures; only models that see images are listed.
{task}遇到有圖的題目時的模型: Model for {task} on questions with pictures
上面的模型看得懂圖就用它: Uses the model above if it sees images
拖曳調整作答空間: Drag to resize the answer space
